data.name: Mehwishta
data.gender_notes: Mehwishta is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Persian language, meaning 'Graceful, Lovely'. This name evokes images of beauty and elegance, making it an ideal choice for parents seeking a unique and meaningful name for their daughter. The name Mehwishta carries the meaning “Graceful, Lovely” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mehwishta usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, lovely and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mehwishta represents the grace and beauty that can be found in the natural world and within oneself. It is a reminder to live a life that is in harmony with nature and to cultivate inner beauty and grace.
data.etymology: Mehwishta belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Lovely.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehwishta total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
